## What landed

- **The J1–J10 journey battery** (`web/tests/e2e/map-journeys.spec.ts`,
  ~470 lines; `web/playwright.journeys.config.ts`): mobile resident
  search→place→In-view→site→share, journalist facet/cite, dossier
  map-frame+print, keyboard-only, SR-proxy live region, z6→z15 street
  regression, basemap failure, no-JS bound, dark theme, reduced motion.
  **10/10 against the committed fixtures** (ordinary `test:e2e` pass)
  and **10/10 against the real-sized deterministic national fixture**
  (232,500 invented sites / 523 pages; 15.3 s) — the runner refuses a
  stale fixture/export dist.
- **Map defects the battery caught, fixed:**
  - Dict-less national place-group rows were dead clicks —
    `tilePlaceRowsInView` now derives an evidence-only fallback frame
    (mean of the group's own drawn cell centroids at
    `NATIONAL_ZOOM_MAX+1`); dictionary bbox still preferred.
  - Tile-path selections never wrote `focus=` — `selectTileProps` now
    updates the workspace URL.
  - Shared `focus=` tile links didn't restore — the focus effect
    consults `tileByRk` first, and a late resolver retries as tile
    sources land (also fixes the late `sourcedata` list refresh).
  - National J6 anchored on a hardcoded coordinate with no synthetic
    site — now reads the first published feature of `sites.geojson`,
    failing loudly if absent.
- **Ops declaration** (`ops/src/ops/map_acceptance.py`, `sig-ops
  map-acceptance plan|check|run`): 8 legs — `journeys-fixture` +
  `budgets-fixture` (deterministic, executed), `candidate-tiles` +
  `candidate-lhci` (ride P37.65a), `live-journeys` / `live-lhci` /
  `live-tiles` / `cost-7d` (ride P37.65b, then +7d). Gated legs queue
  exit 42 with the verbatim `live_verification=true` re-run prompt.
- **CI wiring:** `journeys` leg in `scripts/ci/national_budget_leg.sh`
  (guards `"dataSource":"national"`, previews built dist) + the perf-job
  step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
